## Publications

::: {.writing-item}
<p class="item-meta">Conference paper · CVPR 2022</p>

### ISNAS-DIP: Image-Specific Neural Architecture Search for Deep Image Prior

**Metin Ersin Arıcan\*, Özgür Kara\*, Gustav Bredell, and Ender Konukoğlu**  
*Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition*, 1960–1968, 2022.  
\* Equal contribution.

We show that the best neural architecture in the Deep Image Prior framework depends on the image, then introduce an efficient search strategy for selecting architectures for image restoration without fully training every candidate.

## Thesis

::: {.writing-item}
<p class="item-meta">M.Sc. thesis · Boğaziçi University · 2026</p>

### VC-density in pairs of strongly minimal structures

**Advisor:** [Ayhan Günaydın](https://web.bogazici.edu.tr/ayhan.gunaydin/)

This work studies bounds on the combinatorial complexity of definable families in pairs of models of a strongly minimal theory.

## Expository writing

My public mathematical notes currently include selected solutions to exercises from David Marker's *Model Theory: An Introduction*. They are collected on the [Notes](notes.qmd) page.

## Selected formalization projects

::: {.writing-item}
<p class="item-meta">Collaborative project · Boğaziçi University</p>

### Formalizing quantifier elimination in Lean

With four undergraduate students and [Ayhan Günaydın](https://web.bogazici.edu.tr/ayhan.gunaydin/), I formalized the back-and-forth method for quantifier elimination and applied it to prove that the theory of dense linear orders without endpoints admits quantifier elimination.
:::
